input._script:
using JSON3

sh(c) = try strip(read(`bash -c $c`, String)) catch e; "ERR: "*sprint(showerror,e) end

r = Dict{String,Any}()
# Env vars that only exist if `module load` actually ran.
for k in ("PATH","MODULEPATH","LOADEDMODULES","_LMFILES_","LD_LIBRARY_PATH","OPAL_PREFIX")
    r[k] = get(ENV, k, "<unset>")
end
r["module_is_shell_fn"] = sh("declare -F module >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo yes || echo no")
r["module_type"]        = sh("type -t module 2>&1 || echo undefined")
r["which_mpirun"]       = sh("command -v mpirun || echo none")
r["modulefiles_dir"]    = sh("ls /softs/nvidia/hpc_sdk/modulefiles/nvhpc-hpcx-cuda12/ 2>&1 | head -20")
r["module_init"]        = sh("ls /usr/share/Modules/init/bash /etc/profile.d/modules.sh /usr/share/lmod/lmod/init/bash 2>&1")
r["mpirun_candidates"]  = sh("find /softs/nvidia/hpc_sdk -maxdepth 6 -name mpirun -type f 2>/dev/null | head -10")
r["module_load_direct"] = sh("source /etc/profile.d/modules.sh 2>/dev/null; module load /softs/nvidia/hpc_sdk/modulefiles/nvhpc-hpcx-cuda12/24.1 2>&1 && command -v mpirun || echo FAILED")

println(JSON3.write(Dict("diag" => r)))
